title: Your First Loop
subject: Code
description: Make the computer do the boring part for you.

quiz.prompt: How many times does this run?  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
quiz.explain: i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — that's five passes. It stops the moment i reaches 5.

quiz.prompt: What are the three things every loop needs?
choices: A name, a type, and a value
Where to start, when to stop, and how to move
A sensor, a motor, and a delay
quiz.explain: Miss any one and the loop either never starts, never stops, or never gets anywhere.

quiz.prompt: A while loop checks the sensor, but you forgot to re-read it inside the loop. What happens?
choices: It never ends — the condition can never change
quiz.explain: That's an infinite loop. Before writing one, always ask: what inside this loop will eventually make the condition false?
